items.source:
Executes all queued commands in a transaction started with RedisTxCommands.multi().
If used along with RedisTxCommands.watch(byte[]...) the operation will fail if any of watched keys has been modified.

执行由 RedisTxCommands.multi() 启动的事务中的所有排队命令。

items.source:

Commands will be queued and can then be executed by calling RedisTxCommands.exec() or rolled back using RedisTxCommands.discard()

标记事务块的开始。
命令将被排队，随后可以通过调用 RedisTxCommands.exec() 执行，或使用 RedisTxCommands.discard() 回滚。

items.source:
Indicates whether the connection is in "queue"(or "MULTI") mode or not. When queueing, all commands are postponed
until EXEC or DISCARD commands are issued. Since in queueing no results are returned, the connection will return
NULL on all operations that interact with the data.
items.translation: 指示连接是否处于"队列"(或"MULTI")模式。当启用队列时，所有命令将推迟执行，直到发出 EXEC 或 DISCARD 命令为止。由于在队列模式下不会返回任何结果，因此与数据交互的所有操作都将返回 NULL。

items.source: RedisConnection implementation on top of Jedis library.
items.translation: 基于 Jedis 库实现的 RedisConnection。

items.source: Activates the pipeline mode for this connection. When pipelined, all commands return null (the reply is read at the end through RedisConnection.closePipeline(). Calling this method when the connection is already pipelined has no effect. Pipelining is used for issuing commands without requesting the response right away but rather at the end of the batch. While somewhat similar to MULTI, pipelining does not guarantee atomicity - it only tries to improve performance when issuing a lot of commands (such as in batching scenarios).
items.translation: 启用此连接的管道模式。当处于管道模式时，所有命令均返回 null（回复将在最后通过RedisConnection.closePipeline()读取）。如果连接已经处于管道模式，调用此方法将不会产生任何效果。 管道模式用于在不立即请求响应的情况下发出命令，而是在批次结束时统一获取响应。虽然与 MULTI 有些相似，但管道模式并不保证原子性——它仅在发出大量命令（例如在批量操作场景中）时尝试提升性能。

items.source:
Consider doing some performance testing before using this feature since in many cases the performance benefits are
minimal yet the impact on usage are not.
items.translation: 在使用此功能之前，建议先进行性能测试，因为在许多情况下，其带来的性能提升微乎其微，但对使用体验的影响却不容忽视。

items.source:
Subscribes the connection to all channels matching the given patterns. Once subscribed, a connection enters
listening mode and can only subscribe to other channels or unsubscribe. No other commands are accepted until the
connection is unsubscribed.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到所有匹配给定模式的频道。一旦订阅成功，连接即进入监听模式，此时只能订阅其他频道或取消订阅，在取消订阅之前不接受任何其他命令。

items.source:
Subscribes the connection to the given channels. Once subscribed, a connection enters listening mode and can only
subscribe to other channels or unsubscribe. No other commands are accepted until the connection is unsubscribed.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到指定的频道。一旦订阅成功，连接即进入监听模式，此时仅可订阅其他频道或取消订阅，在取消订阅之前不接受任何其他命令。
